test_title: PYST 30: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The marked price of a bed is ₹744, which is 36% above the cost price. If the profit percentage is 20%, find the discount percentage (rounded off to two decimal places).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100 units.

Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 36% of 100 = 136 units.

Selling Price (SP) = 100 + 20% of 100 = 120 units.

Discount = MP − SP = 136 − 120 = 16 units.

Discount % = (16 ÷ 136) × 100 = (2 ÷ 17) × 100 ≈ 11.76%.

Decimal value = 11.76%.

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Marked Price (MP) = ₹744

Mark-up Percentage = 36%

Profit Percentage = 20%

Formula Used:

MP = CP × (1 + Markup%/100)

SP = CP × (1 + Profit%/100)

Discount % = [(MP − SP) ÷ MP] × 100

 
• CP SP MP (744) 
 Mark-up: +36% 
 Profit: +20% 
 Discount: ? 

⇒ CP = 744 ÷ (1 + 36/100) = 744 ÷ 1.36

⇒ CP = 547.0588

⇒ SP = CP × (1 + 20/100) = 547.0588 × 1.20

⇒ SP = 656.4705

⇒ Discount = MP − SP = 744 − 656.4705 = 87.5295

⇒ Discount % = (87.5295 ÷ 744) × 100

⇒ Discount % ≈ 11.7647%

⇒ In decimal form = 11.76%

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between CP and MP

The direct ratio of MP to CP is given by: MP/CP = (100 + Profit%) / (100 − Discount%).

Marked Price Formula

MP = SP + Discount = CP + Mark-up amount. Mark-up is always calculated on the Cost Price.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts d₁ and d₂ are given, the single equivalent discount is (d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂)/100)%.
